name: Persistent Continuity
description: A persistent continuity and memory architecture for Claude Code that enables resumable cognition, operational continuity, multi-session persistence, and intelligent project state restoration.

capabilities.title: Continuity Ledgers
capabilities.description: Maintains structured project continuity across sessions using persistent ledgers and handoff artifacts.

capabilities.title: Session Restoration
capabilities.description: Automatically restores operational context, decisions, plans, and active work state.

capabilities.title: Persistent Memory
capabilities.description: Stores long-term architectural and procedural memory beyond Claude context windows.

capabilities.title: Project Awareness
capabilities.description: Tracks repository structure, execution history, and project-specific operational patterns.

capabilities.title: Session Handoffs
capabilities.description: Creates resumable execution handoffs for future Claude sessions.

steps: Clone the repository into your local development environment.
Install dependencies and configure Claude Code integration.
Initialize continuity ledgers and persistent storage.
Launch Claude Code with Persistent Continuity enabled.

optional.description: Automatically restore previous project continuity state.
Persistence backend mode: local, hybrid, or distributed.
